caption: Note: a note on the graph saying what the wave is for - the effect unchanged
why: A graph that made sense when you built it may not a month later, or to someone else. Note is text on the graph: what a part is for, why a value is what it is, what to try.

Its neighbours: Frame titles a group of nodes; a node's own title can be renamed; Note is free text anywhere. It changes nothing on the LEDs - the picture is the graph's own; the node is for whoever reads the graph.
steps: **text** is the note itself - here, what the wave does and which value to change for more stripes.
It sits beside the **Wave** it talks about; drag it anywhere.
The note can run over several lines (edit it in the Properties pane).

try.label: Say something else
try.text: text set to a reminder: the note changes, the effect does not.
set: Try the Wave's shape: square for hard stripes.

params.text: The Wave makes the stripes: its cycles is how many fit across.
